```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path

from itables import show
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import ticker
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

RESULTS_PATH = Path("../results")
POST_PATH = RESULTS_PATH / "model-posterior"
COLOR = "darkslategrey"

langs_all = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "languages.parquet")
w = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "words.parquet")
s = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "syllables.parquet")
langs = langs_all.filter(
    pl.col("iso639p3code").is_in(set(w.get_column("iso639p3code")))
)

sf_subtlex = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "syllables_freq_subtlex.parquet")
sf_childes = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "syllables_freq_childes.parquet")
p_ssp = pl.read_parquet(POST_PATH / "ssp.parquet")
p_freq_subtlex = pl.read_parquet(POST_PATH / "freq_subtlex.parquet")
p_freq_childes = pl.read_parquet(POST_PATH / "freq_childes.parquet")

cols = set(langs.columns).intersection(w.columns)
w = w.join(langs, on=list(cols)).with_columns(
    pl.col("word").str.len_chars().alias("n_char")
)
s = s.join(langs, on=list(cols)).with_columns(n_phon=pl.col("syll").str.len_chars())
```

## Row

### Column {width=40%}

#### Row {height="40%"}

```{python}
#| label: available-languages
data = (
    langs_all.with_columns(
        status=pl.when(pl.col("iso639p3code").is_in(w["iso639p3code"].to_list()))
        .then(pl.lit("Available"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Not available"))
    )
    .group_by("status")
    .len("n")
)

values = data["n"]
labels = [f"{s}\n({n:,}, {n / sum(values):.2%})" for s, n in data.iter_rows()]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
p = ax.pie(
    values,
    labels=labels,
    radius=1,
    wedgeprops=dict(width=0.5, edgecolor="w"),
    colors=[COLOR, "lightgrey"],
)
```

#### Row {height="60%"}

```{python}
#| label: available-families
fig_data = langs.group_by("family_id").len("n").sort("n")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
ax.barh(fig_data["family_id"], fig_data["n"], color=COLOR)
for f, n in fig_data.iter_rows():
    _ = ax.text(n, f, s=n, ha="left", va="center")
ax.spines[["right", "top"]].set_visible(False)
# ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=90)
fig.set_size_inches(6, 6)
```
